capabilities: ingest vault notes into a vector store for question answering
chat with a GPT-powered bot about your notes
generate embeddings locally or through the OpenAI API
open the chat from the ribbon or command palette
re-run ingestion to index newly added notes
extras: Requires Docker to run the brAIn server. Embedding generation can be slow and resource-heavy locally, or cost roughly $1 per 1000 notes via the OpenAI API. Warns that the bot may produce incorrect content; the author aims for a fully offline LLM chatbot in the future.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to ask natural-language questions and get answers grounded in the contents of your own vault notes.
summary: ChatGPT-powered chatbot that answers questions about your vault notes using a local Docker server and OpenAI embeddings.
